title: Emby Playback Reporting imports
summary: Playback Reporting history from Emby can now be imported from a TSV backup, playback_reporting.db, or the installed plugin. This compatibility is limited to history imports; Jellydash is still built and tested for Jellyfin.
highlights: Accept Emby's numeric user and item IDs while keeping Jellyfin GUID imports unchanged.
Read Emby's additional Playback Reporting columns and exclude paused time from the watched total.
Keep the complete elapsed session time for History dates, even when a session contains pauses.
Detect PauseDuration before a live plugin import and fall back to the existing Jellyfin query when the column is unavailable.
